hero.title: Find your rhythm.
hero.lead: Taal Yatra brings people together through facilitated drum circles and music workshops — for teams at work, families at home, and anyone who wants a fresh, joyful way to spend time. No experience needed.

trust.title: Facilitator-led
trust.text: A trained facilitator guides every beat, from the warm-up to the finale.

trust.title: A drum for everyone
trust.text: Every participant plays. Nobody sits and watches.

trust.title: 10 to 5,000 people
trust.text: From one small team to a full auditorium.

trust.title: Indoors or outdoors
trust.text: Offices, lawns, banquet halls and stages.
